propositions: Writing-a-passing-plan guide must explain that risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) must be de-risked with concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codification.
Guide must identify the new de-risk guidance as T15 and cite it in criterion-pins.json so authors can locate the corresponding rubric.

Guide must specify two permitted forms of fast proof: local run or manual probe against real target, and must require throwaway experiment teardown scoped only to resources created by that experiment.
Hand-authored overlay enumeration in docs/plan-review-gate.md must be updated from stale T1–T12 range to T1–T15 with criterion count aligned to validated registry (44 total).
Registry module docstring in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py must state validated 44 criteria and T1–T15 vocabulary to remain aligned with author-facing docs.
All new guidance must remain stack-agnostic without hardcoding product-specific mechanisms like Terraform or Docker.
